insights.text: An AWS billing-estimate subsystem bug (bad unit-price values, not a metering fault) showed some customers projected charges in the billions or trillions of dollars starting ~7:38 PM PDT July 16; a UK charity that normally pays under £1/month saw a £5.8 billion projection. Real invoices were unaffected.

Apple's trade-secrets suit against OpenAI (filed July 10, naming chief hardware officer Tang Tan and citing 400+ former Apple employees now at OpenAI) is now framed by Bloomberg and TechCrunch as an active threat to OpenAI's expected IPO timing, not just a hardware-poaching dispute.

PrismML's ternary-quantized Bonsai 27B is now confirmed running on a real iPhone 17 Pro Max at ~11 tok/s via MLX Swift (3.9GB, ~90% baseline quality retained), moving from vendor benchmark claim to community-corroborated on-device deployment.

Kimi K3 wins blind developer coding-preference votes against Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on front-end code specifically, even though Moonshot's own published benchmark table shows K3 trailing both models on aggregate — a narrower, more specific win than r/LocalLLaMA's 'writing on the wall for Anthropic and OpenAI' framing suggests.

TP-Link Kasa EC70/EC71 v4 cameras shipped with an unauthenticated discovery endpoint leaking GPS coordinates in cleartext (CVE-2026-13230) and a hardcoded firmware crypto key enabling MITM credential theft (CVE-2026-9770); both are now patched.

Mozilla, Cloudflare, Chrome, Edge, and Firefox are jointly designing PACT (Private Access Control Tokens) — anonymous, unlinkable tokens that prove a human or authorized agent without identity disclosure, meant to replace CAPTCHAs and forced logins. Still proposal-stage, no origin trial yet.

OpenCut's GitHub star velocity cooled from +3,537/day at launch (07-17) to +1,074/day today while its total keeps climbing (75,010) — a normal post-launch cooldown, with the promised headless mode/MCP server/Rust core rewrite still unconfirmed as shipped.

Astronomy apps Star Walk 2 Plus and Stellarium both sit in today's Play Store top 30 the same day HN's #6 story covers the first atmosphere found on an Earth-like planet in a habitable zone — a plausible but unconfirmed space-news-to-app-store-attention correlation worth re-checking on a future major astronomy story.

Apple's trade-secrets suit against OpenAI is now framed by Bloomberg and TechCrunch as an active threat to OpenAI's expected IPO timing, not just a hardware-poaching dispute.

PrismML's ternary-quantized Bonsai 27B is now confirmed running on a real iPhone 17 Pro Max at ~11 tok/s via MLX Swift , moving from vendor benchmark claim to community-corroborated on-device deployment.

takeaway.text: AWS's estimated-billing bug and Apple's newly IPO-threatening OpenAI suit both show trust cracking at the infrastructure and legal layers of the AI boom, while Bonsai 27B's confirmed iPhone deployment, Kimi K3's narrow-but-real coding-arena wins, and Mozilla's PACT proposal show the counter-trend: real progress on local capability and anonymous-by-design privacy infrastructure.
